title: Rava bar Yishmael
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Moed Katan 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.6b.14), the statement is attributed to Rava bar Yishmael or, in the alternative, Rav Yeima bar Shelamya. In [Ketubot 10b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.10b.11), the text reads Rava son of Rabbi Yishmael.[^1]

notes.text: Both consulted passages write Rav Yeimar bar Shelamya for the alternative. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3099&lang=en) cites both with that spelling. Hyman’s alternative is written Yeima.
